model: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct on fixed-tile-unsplit-v1. Exact phase-metrics binary, application-level prefill through the existing chat API. One host and two A100s.
protocol: Warm each fresh process with identical fixed replay. Each natural chain uses the same actual 100ms tool wait and one dependent result. Only intervene after the second observed call. The history arm re-renders the observed preceding messages without tools. The boundary arm also includes the completed assistant tool call and an empty result placeholder, never the future result. Discard its one output token. Send the real final HTTP call as soon as the real tool returns, even when preparation is unfinished. Capture true result and document hashes, actual cache gain, work and prepare completion relative to tool ready, TTFT, workflow first and last visible, gap p95, validity, generated length. A separate reader in each of two new scenarios starts its final answer before the target begins its second tool wait. Validate peer output and gaps. Paired device results are descriptive; two outside arms are reversed; middle arm has residual order bias.
gate: A general opt-in candidate must save final TTFT and total workflow completion in all three previously high-opportunity cases on both devices, retain basic validity, avoid >5% regressions in completion on any paired case or peer p95 visible intervals, and must avoid >5% increase in summed GPU execution for the same natural chain including its prep. Keep every failed or changed answer and shape. Report per-case gains and counts even if the candidate fails. No automatic service default change.
